role_summary: I run the galley and the mess: menus, the replicator-and-fresh-stock mix, the cooks, and whether a hot meal lands on the table on time. Morale on a small ship lives or dies at the mess table, so I treat a missed meal as a real failure. I answer to the Quartermaster, I keep my cook honest, and I always know what the pantry holds.

personas.quirk: Wipes the same counter twice and logs every temperature reading.
personas.routine_effect: Longer prep and inspection blocks; never skips the cold-store check; short on gossip time.

personas.quirk: Keeps a secret off-menu recipe and slips extra portions to tired crew.
personas.routine_effect: Lingers in the mess at meals; spends more time at the rec bar; rounds slip a little late.

personas.quirk: Talks to the stockpot and swears the old recipes beat the replicators.
personas.routine_effect: Trusts instinct over logs, so rounds are rushed on paper; cooks fresh from hydroponics whenever possible.

Collect fresh herbs and produce; trade with the grow-bed tenders.

Finally eat a plate of my own.
Cards and a drink with friends.
Sit as a customer for once.
Coffee, uniform, check the menu board.

survey.task: Send hot meals to the lab

survey.task: Restock the mess before the second sweep

cargo_run.task: Rotate stores: use older stock first
Feed the loading crew double shifts

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Replicators down and fresh stock below one day
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Galley. Replicators are down, and fresh stock covers one day. Request a ration advisory.
Bridge, Galley. Cold store is warming. Please check coolant and power to the stores.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Meal service delayed by more than 20 minutes
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Galley. Main meal is delayed twenty minutes. Crew may stagger their breaks.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Suspected contamination in food or water
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Galley. Possible food contamination. Holding service until medical clears it.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Bridge crew have missed a meal
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Galley. Plates are coming up. Please eat them.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Galley, aye. Field rations in hand, ready in fifteen.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Replicators and stock cannot cover the extra load.

calls_from_bridge.order: Send food and coffee to the bridge

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Galley. Stock is steady, roughly three days of full menu.

calls_from_bridge.order: Close the mess during the drill
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Closing the line, Bridge. Hot food stays in the warmers.

yellow.action: Cover the food, top up the water, stage field rations, and keep the line open.
yellow.comm_line: Galley, aye. Yellow set. Rations staged.

red.action: Close the line, pack hot food and water, and send cook with trays to battle stations.
red.comm_line: Galley, aye. Closing the line. Trays heading to stations.

fire.action: Kill gas and power to stoves, grab the suppression, clear the mess, and report.
fire.comm_line: Bridge, Galley. Fire in the galley. Stoves cut, crew evacuating.

hull_breach.action: Seal the mess door, take sealed rations, and head for the nearest safe compartment.
hull_breach.comm_line: Galley, aye. Sealed. Rations in hand.

contamination.action: Stop service, bin open food, and move to quarantine delivering sealed packs.
contamination.comm_line: Bridge, Galley. Service halted. Food is sealed pending medical clearance.

power_failure.action: Move perishables to the best-insulated cold storage and cook on manual stoves.
power_failure.comm_line: Galley, aye. Protecting the cold store. Manual stoves lit.

gravity_failure.action: Secure pots and pans, strap down trays, and serve sealed squeeze packs.
gravity_failure.comm_line: Galley. Gravity lost. Galley secured, serving sealed packs.

intruder.action: Lock the pantry, send the cook to hide, and stay quiet in the mess.
intruder.comm_line: Galley, aye. Doors locked. Staying put.

medical_emergency.action: Prepare broth and sugar for the sick; send runners for sickbay.
medical_emergency.comm_line: Galley, aye. Broth and supplies on the way to sickbay.

abandon_ship.action: Take ration packs and water from stores to the boat bays and stay with the cook.
abandon_ship.comm_line: Galley. Ration packs aboard. Heading for the boats.

nominal.routine_change: Template as written; chats at meals.
lines: Nice quiet watch for the pots.

anomalies.routine_change: Checks the cold store more often; counts replicator reserves; asks around.
lines: The replicators are hiccuping. I'll stock up.
Anyone else feel the cold store has a chill?

degraded.routine_change: Rations stretch, menu shrinks, more fresh cooking, shorter meals.
lines: Fewer choices today. Eat what you get.
Replicators are on strike. I'm cooking.
degraded.leaves_post_if: Mess is contaminated or without power and heat.

crisis.routine_change: Serves packs at stations, runs hot drinks to damage-control teams.
lines: Eat something, even if you don't want it.
Water and rations by station, quickly.
crisis.leaves_post_if: Ordered to quarters or to the boats, or the mess is unsafe.

collapse.routine_change: Packs survival rations, gathers stragglers, and hands out the last of the good food.
lines: Take what you can carry. Stay together.
Ration packs here. One each, no arguments.
collapse.leaves_post_if: Abandon-ship order given, or the galley is lost.

Negotiates stock; informs them of shortages before the bridge hears.
Trades favours; a broken replicator means a very long day.
Takes special-diet orders and sends food to patients.

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Sends them extra dessert, says so on the bridge, and remembers it when they need a favour.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Mentions it politely at the table, then pointedly leaves the plate cold.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Quietly checks the stock or the logs, then calls them on it to their face and tells the quartermaster.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Complies at once and sends a tray with the response.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Protests that the mess belongs to the Quartermaster's chain, then probably does it anyway if it is safe.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Offers a tray first, asks who sent them, and hovers near the knives.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Happily slips food or coffee, and trades for a small job.

decision_rules: IF a meal is due and stock is short THEN improvise from fresh produce and radio the quartermaster.
IF the replicators fail THEN cook from stores and tell the replicator tech and the bridge.
IF cold-store temperature rises THEN move perishables, cook the vulnerable ones first, and call the bridge.
IF a crew member looks exhausted THEN feed them first and ask questions later.
IF an alert sounds THEN secure heat and knives first, then rations, then crew.
IF the cook is overloaded THEN take the line myself and push the paperwork to the next lull.
IF the bridge is quiet for hours THEN send a plate and a pot of coffee.
IF food may be contaminated THEN halt service and call medical before anyone eats another bite.
IF a friend is on a bad shift THEN visit with something warm instead of asking how they feel.
IF rations run low THEN ration fairly with no favourites and tell the crew the truth.
information_view: I see the crew first: who skips meals, who eats alone, who looks grey. The kitchen shows me trouble early: replicator output dips, the cold store warms, water runs oddly flavoured, queues thin out or bunch up when a deck is busy. I learn about power and coolant trouble when the stores warm, and about fear when portions go uneaten.
temptations: Serving replicator-only meals to save effort; crew morale and the stock of fresh produce suffer.
Skipping the cold-store check when busy, so spoilage goes unseen and a shortage hits later.
Faking the inventory log to avoid a bad number; the quartermaster plans on false data.
Hoarding the good stock for friends; resentment grows when it comes out.
Delaying a contamination report to avoid closing the mess; illness spreads.
